paragraphs: A Tanna, mentioned in a baraita in Yoma 44b. See also the entry on R' Shimon ben ha-Segan.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Yoma 44b paragraph explicitly attributes the baraita to Ben HaSegan. The separate cross-reference to R' Shimon ben ha-Segan remains unbound, with its abbreviated title retained; this does not identify Ben HaSegan with that target or add any of the baraita’s legal details.
